scenes.subject: Iris violeta, rocío, oscuridad de estudio
scenes.image: Ultra-photorealistic extreme macro still of a single deep-violet iris petal emerging from absolute black studio background; realistic radial veins, tiny spherical dew droplets with believable surface tension, rich amethyst-purple pigment, one large clear droplet centered in the left third, exquisite texture, 100 mm macro lens look at high magnification, thin sharp focus plane, restrained cool rim-light from upper left and faint warm lower bounce; genuine optical bokeh, high-end botanical studio photography, landscape 16:9, no text, no graphics, no artificial CGI gloss.
scenes.video: 10-second photorealistic macro cinematography. Lock the iris petal's species, silhouette, veins, proportions, texture, and position throughout; no morphing or deformation. 0–2s ENTRY: from the existing black studio, a delicate upper-left rim-light sweep and slow focus reveal bring the same violet iris and dew into view; make the transition visibly gradual, not a hard cut. 2–7s: hold a legible stable iris macro with one almost imperceptible forward camera push; a bead refracts the existing light without moving unnaturally. 7–10s EXIT: let that bead's highlight bloom gently into a soft violet optical bokeh at the left third as focus eases away; keep the iris geometry fixed. End with the violet orb on the left and black negative space on the right, cueing BB-002's violet refracted-light entry. All effects are within these 10 seconds; no added editor transition, no jitter or flicker.

scenes.video: 10-second photorealistic macro cinematography. Preserve the supplied violet/lilac droplet endpoint exactly at first; keep its position, shape, and surface stable. 0–2s ENTRY: a soft refracted highlight glides through the droplet and shifts focus gradually to reveal a separate ivory rose petal in the same black studio, with no droplet-to-flower transformation. 2–7s: show a recognizable, sharply legible layered ivory rose macro; keep petal geometry stable while a subtle pearl highlight travels along one real petal edge. scenes.subject: Caléndula ámbar, borde luminoso
scenes.image: Extreme realistic macro studio photograph of the thin curled edge of a single golden-orange calendula petal on seamless black; a delicate soft crescent-shaped pale-amber rim highlight occupies right third corresponding to previous rose glow; petal cuticle grooves and natural pollen grains, directional professional studio rim light upper left, muted honey-amber tonality with no oversaturation, organic dimensional texture and natural shallow depth of field, 16:9.
scenes.video: 10-second photorealistic macro cinematography. Start from the actual BB-003 saved rose endpoint and preserve the rose's geometry while it is visible. 0–2s ENTRY: a narrow warm rim-light sweep travels along the incoming ivory crescent and shifts gradually toward amber; a realistic defocused pollen glint passes across the lens. 2–7s: use the glint and slow rack focus to reveal a separate single orange calendula emerging from shadow in the same black studio; do not turn the rose into the calendula. Keep both subjects geometrically stable, avoid overlap, and hold the calendula's radial grooves clearly in focus. 7–10s EXIT: lower the backlight gradually and let one amber petal reflection soften into a small low-center orange-green bud silhouette, still visible against black, to cue BB-005. No full-black cut, hard cut, morphing, deformation, or added editor transition.

scenes.exit: Small orange-green bud remains visible while the light gradually softens; no full-black cut.
